what_it_is: Big Bang Boom Solutions (BBBS) is a Chennai-based private defence-technology company founded by Rikesh Raj and Shivakumar. The company builds counter-UAS and electronic-warfare systems, headlined by the Vajra Sentinel anti-drone system - an AI-enabled RF detect-and-defeat product line - and the Vajra Shot man-portable anti-drone gun. Its catalogue targets detection ranges in the km-class and 360-degree coverage against commercial off-the-shelf drone threats.
india_angle: Vajra Sentinel has been publicly reported as delivered to the Indian Air Force, and BBBS systems have appeared with Indian security units including NSG teams using the Vajra Shot anti-drone gun. The company positions itself as a Make-in-India counter-drone supplier for air bases and critical-infrastructure protection.
intelligence_assessment: BBBS is one of the few Indian private C-UAS vendors with public delivery reporting to a theatre-relevant customer. Contract values, quantities and sustainment arrangements remain undisclosed, so scale should be treated as unverified; product-level performance claims come primarily from the vendor and trade press rather than government releases.

faq.a: Vajra Sentinel is Big Bang Boom Solutions' AI-enabled counter-drone system that detects RF-controlled commercial drones and neutralises them; trade press has reported deliveries to the Indian Air Force.

faq.q: Who makes the Vajra Shot anti-drone gun?
faq.a: The Vajra Shot man-portable anti-drone gun is made by Chennai-based Big Bang Boom Solutions and has been publicly seen with Indian security units.

faq.q: Is Big Bang Boom Solutions an Indian company?
faq.a: Yes - it is a private Indian defence-technology startup headquartered in Chennai.
